property_summary: C.transfer returns true and does not revert iff _tos is non-empty and every low-level call to caddress returns true for each _tos element (i.e., when it would succeed), and when it returns true the function returns true.
If transfer returns (does not revert) then it must return true and _tos must be non-empty.
If transfer does not revert then it returns true and performs at least one external call (i.e., _tos.length > 0).
